units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 12:1">Sabb. XII, 1</cite> <he>הקוֹדֵחַ וכ׳</he> he who bores a hole ever so small.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 11:3">Tosef. ib. XI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:3">XII</cite>), 3 <he>עד שיִקְדַּח את כולו</he> until he bores as far as is needed for his purpose; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 6:1:12">Y. Pes. VI, 33ᵇ</cite> top.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 4">Lev. R. s. 4</cite> <he>נטל … והתחיל קוֹדֵחַ תחתיו</he> one of the passengers of the ship took a borer and began to bore under the place assigned to him; <he>לא תחתי אני קודח</he> have I no right to bore in my place? <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 58a">Ab. Zar. 58ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M01233"><he>מֵינֶקֶת</he></cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 5:4">Tosef. B. Bath. V, 4</cite> <he>קודח</he> ed. Zuck., read: <cite ref="S00425"><he>קוֹנֵחַ</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: (b. h.; to burn, rise in a column and spread sparks; [b. h. also to enkindle]. Y. B. Kam. VI, 5ᶜ top (ref. to Mish.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 6:4">B. Kam. VI, 4</cite>) <he>בקוֹדַחַת … אבל במקטפת וכ׳</he> the Mishnah speaks of a fire which (unexpectedly) blazes up and spreads, but in the case of a creeping fire all agree &c.; Bab.

senses.gloss: to cut out, make an opening. Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵃ bot. ה׳ לו … ככברה the Lord made for him an opening (in the clouds) of the size of a K’barah (v. כְּבָרָה), and the moon became visible within it.
to cause burning, to spoil a dish, a dye &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 9:4">B. Kam. IX, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Kamma 100b:2">100ᵇ</cite>) <he>הִקְדִּיחָתוֹ יורה</he> (Bab. ed. <cite ref="S00125"><he>הִקְדִּיחוֹ</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="J00240"><he>יוֹרֶה</he> II</cite>. Y. ib. IX, 6ᵈ bot. <he>שהִקְדִּיחוּ סממנין</he> when the dyes burned the material, <he>אבל הִקְדִּיחָה יורה וכ׳</he> but if the boiler burned &c.
<cite ref="Eruvin 53b:18">Erub. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>הִקְדִּיחָתָן במלח</he> she spoiled them (the beans) by oversalting.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 9:10">Gitt. IX, 10</cite> <he>אפי׳ הקדיחה תבשילו</he> if she spoiled a dish for him (he may divorce her).

<cite ref="Beitzah 29a:15">Bets. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>כדי שלא יַקְדִּיחַ תבשילו</he> so as not to spoil his dish (by spicing it too much or too little); Ar. <he>שלא יַקְדִּיחוּ וכ׳</he> that they (the spices) may not burn &c.
Tosef. B. Kam. X, 9 המוליך … והִקְדִּיחוֹ if one gives meat to a cook, and he spoils it; a. fr.—Trnsf. ה׳ תבשילו to misapply learning, disgrace one’s education; to degenerate.

<cite ref="Berakhot 17b">Ber. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>לא יהא … שמַקְדִּיחַ ת׳ ברבים</he> that we may not have a son or a pupil that disgraces his education in public; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 103a">Snh. 103ᵃ</cite>

senses.gloss: to have fever. Sifra B’ḥuck. Par. 2, ch. IV נוח לו ואינו מקדיח he is comfortable and has no fever; Yalk. Lev. 673.—[Tosef. Maasr. I, 2 משיקדיחו ed. Zuck., v. קָרַח.]
